posts.title: Dolly Sods Wilderness
posts.description: The dolly sods wilderness is one of the top search results when looking for a backpacking route in West Virginia. We had a beautiful trip, we hiked in early Friday morning to avoid the crowds. The sun was shining and we happily heaved our packs onto our shoulders and set out.
